week.summary: The Resolution Foundation has criticized Chancellor John Healey’s new budget as poorly targeted and ineffective at boosting living standards. The thinktank warns that the measures fail to protect the poorest households, leaving Britons facing higher energy bills and a significant drop in disposable income.
week.title: ‘Scattergun’ budget will still leave Britons facing higher energy bills, says thinktank

week.summary: With the 2026 midterm elections approaching, Democrats are heavily favored to win control of the House of Representatives. Both parties are pouring millions into 70 competitive districts to influence the final margin of power. This shift is driven by economic concerns and a wave of retirements that could reshape the legislative landscape.
week.title: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3

week.summary: Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman has been named Caltech associate vice president and deputy director of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. The emeritus astronaut and retired U.S. Navy captain begins his new role at NASA’s center of excellence for robotics and deep space exploration and at Caltech, which manages JPL for NASA, on Nov. 30, 2026.
week.title: Caltech Names Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman as NASA JPL Deputy

week.summary: Missouri activists are conducting door-to-door "deep canvassing" to oppose a proposed constitutional amendment that would ban gender-affirming care for minors. This effort aims to sway undecided voters ahead of the midterms, as the state remains divided on the future of transgender healthcare access.
week.title: Ahead of midterms, Missourians defend transgender healthcare

week.summary: The SportsLine projection model and expert analysts have released their top betting picks for Wednesday’s 12-game NBA slate. The model specifically favors the Philadelphia 76ers to cover as 5.5-point favorites against the Indiana Pacers. These insights are significant for bettors looking to leverage a model that has historically yielded consistent long-term profits.
week.title: 2026 NBA odds, picks, predictions, best bets, player props: Experts, model backing 76ers on Wednesday

week.summary: Twenty years after its release, the *Avatar: The Last Airbender* episode "The Guru" remains a vital touchstone for understanding spiritual growth and emotional trauma. By teaching Aang to clear his chakras, Guru Pathik provides a framework for overcoming fear and guilt that continues to influence modern storytelling in the franchise.
week.title: 20 Years Later, Avatar’s Deepest Episode Has Never Been More Important

week.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez confirmed that at least 69 people died in a major train crash, with victims potentially representing 27 different nationalities. Authorities are investigating a suspected command and control failure to determine the cause and prevent future tragedies.
week.title: Pedro Sánchez says people of 27 nationalities may be among those killed or injured in Spanish train crash – Europe live

week.summary: Salience around AI data centers is growing this election cycle as the fight over the infrastructure's costs and environmental impacts may be threatening Republicans in battleground states like Texas...
week.title: Backlash to AI data centers threatens GOP's grip on Ohio, Texas

week.summary: Security researchers discovered potential backdoors in official Claude Code extensions that could allow unauthorized access to user environments. This vulnerability poses a significant risk to developers, as it could lead to the theft of sensitive data or credentials.
week.title: Backdoors in official Claude Code extensions

week.summary: International Space Station crews celebrate Halloween by creating costumes from available materials and posing for photos. These traditions highlight the human side of life in orbit while the station continues its vital role as a long-term scientific research platform.
week.title: Halloween Aboard the International Space Station

week.summary: Nearly two-thirds of American youth now use AI chatbots for schoolwork and emotional support. While the technology helps with tasks, researchers are concerned that relying on AI for mental health support may be linked to poorer well-being in teens and tweens.
week.title: Nearly 2 out of 3 teens and tweens use AI chatbots, new research shows

week.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies and Portland Trail Blazers face off tonight in a matchup of two of the NBA's last three remaining unbeaten teams. This game marks Ja Morant’s first appearance against his former team, the Grizzlies, since being traded to Portland this summer.
week.title: Grizzlies vs. Trail Blazers NBA picks: Portland's Ja Morant could get payback in battle of unbeaten teams

week.summary: Artist Lauren Tsai and My Chemical Romance have released a stop-motion short film set to the band's song "The End." Featuring cameos from Hideo Kojima, Billie Eilish, and Phoebe Bridgers, the project bridges Tsai’s "The Dying World" universe with the band's iconic *Black Parade* lore.
week.title: My Chemical Romance and Lauren Tsai Team Up for Short Movie Featuring Hideo Kojima
